pages.text: Mto Bond Fund factsheet, issued by Jua Asset Managers (SYN). Mto Bond Fund is a bond fund and its objective is to balance income and modest capital growth from fixed income. The management fee of Mto Bond Fund is 1.8 percent per annum. The minimum initial investment in Mto Bond Fund is SYN Sh 5,000, and the minimum top-up is SYN Sh 1,000. Over the 12 months to 2026-09-30 Mto Bond Fund delivered an effective annual yield of 9.7 percent.

Withdrawals from Mto Bond Fund are paid within 2 business days. The main holdings of Mto Bond Fund are corporate bonds (50 percent), bank bonds (30 percent) and bond-like fixed deposits (10 percent). Bara Custodial (SYN) acts as trustee of Mto Bond Fund and holds its assets separately from the manager. Mto Bond Fund was launched in 2009 and is licensed by the SYN Capital Markets Authority. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results and the value of units can fall. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
